scope: Current source and the existing Rustdoc rendered from it; not an exhaustive semver API report or a live-validation result. The 2026-09-29 second refresh adds the dormitory laundry and bottled-water third-party read boundaries on top of the teaching-evaluation form read and its one-shot submission, the per-course score lookup, bank-payroll and graduate-income, e-invoice, degree-program, physical-education, and teaching-evaluation list slices; no live campus request was made for it.
methodology: Public module/method/DTO declarations are counted from source. Rustdoc item links are deduplicated by class and href on the rendered crate root. Counts include deprecated or compatibility items; source line counts include inline tests.
